From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: MAP deliverables and perf evidence we need for evaluation

Thanks Sam — we ran the benchmark matrix against your sample workload (thanks for the dataset). Summary of what we ran and what you'll see in the artifacts below. Raw CSVs and slides are attached to this message and uploaded to the shared Drive link.

Benchmark configuration (high level)
- Model variant: rw-large-quant (4-bit q4) and rw-large-fp16 (reference)
- Hardware: 2x A100-40GB (single-request per GPU, multi-GPU batching for throughput sweeps)
- Inputs: 3k requests (mix of 20% short, 60% medium, 20% long sequences)
- Concurrency targets: 30, 100, 300 parallel sessions sustained over 10m windows
- Measurement: tokenized timestamping for first-token and per-token latency, p50/p95/p99, end-to-end request time

Key results (high level)
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 (rw-large-quant): 18ms / 72ms / 210ms at median seq length (50 tokens).
- First-token latency (FTL): 12ms median; FTL variance driven by long-context KV cache hits.
- Throughput: sustained token throughput of ~1.1M tokens/min on fp16; q4 showed ~1.05M tokens/min with ~8% lower cost per token.
- Concurrency resilience: at 300 concurrent sessions we observed a 7% increase in p99 and occasional soft-queueing; no hard failures, automatic fallback to lower-batch path triggered at 320+ RPS.
- TTFT (time to first token served under cold-start): median cold TTFT observed ~230ms for the first request after model spin-up; warm requests ~12–20ms.

Artifacts delivered (attached + Drive):
- Acme_MAP_Perf_Deck_v1.pptx (executive slides, 9 slides)
- acme_latency_throughput_v1.csv (per-request token timestamps)
- acme_concurrency_first-token.csv (per-session first-token timings)
- perf_dashboard_link: https://redwood-inference.app/dashboards/acme/perf (access expires 2024-05-10)
- evidence_readme.txt (mapping from CSV columns to measurement code)

Notes / risk callouts:
- These runs were on representative but synthetic traffic; we recommend one more short validation run on your exact prod traffic before the final procurement decision.
- CSVs are scrubbed of customer PII — we redacted any free-form user text (per your request).
- SOC2 pointers: see Drive/Compliance/SOC2_summary.pdf (I copied Laura on how to share with legal; we can also provide a temporary scoped audit log export).

Attachments: Acme_MAP_Perf_Deck_v1.pptx, acme_latency_throughput_v1.csv, acme_concurrency_first-token.csv

Happy to walk through these in the readout. Suggested slots: Tue 2024-04-30 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 2024-05-01 14:00–14:45 PT.

—Marissa Cole
Applied Performance Lead
Redwood Inference
